key_insight: LF-ENN combines neural approximation with structure-preserving enrichment to provide a rigorous locking-free guarantee for nearly incompressible linear elasticity.
engineering_relevance: The method enables accurate displacement prediction without volumetric locking as materials approach incompressibility.
method: Combine linearized neural trial spaces with enriched Galerkin structure.
Reduce discrete incompressibility constraints to a graph-Laplacian problem for divergence-free corrections.
Use Nitsche boundary enforcement and tailored stabilization.
evidence_signal: Reported 2D and 3D experiments confirm locking-free behavior, with approximately 12× smaller displacement error than a higher-order locking-free enriched Galerkin method using fewer than one-third as many unknowns.
watch_item: The theoretical guarantees require suitable approximation and mesh-resolution assumptions; fewer unknowns alone do not establish lower computational cost.
paper_title: A locking-free enriched linearized neural network for linear elasticity
